scope: Public original source review, no policy transformation or amended policy accepted

sepol_check_access.used: One permission per invocation, original libsepol computes default conditional/TE/constraint/RBAC decisions
sepol_check_access.limitation: Original multi-permission loop assigns av instead of accumulating, so these tests use exactly one permission; not a kernel decision/enforcement claim

sepolicy_check.reason: Source presence scanner includes conditional avtab and uint16 permission mask; not an effective full-policy access decision oracle

seamendc.reason: Original cil_amend_policydb defines types/attributes but skips role/user/bool/sensitivity symbols and multiple rule kinds; neverallow logs warning instead of being installed as a check in apply_rules. Binary policy lacks full original assertions. Source is insufficient for treating it as a full safe policy composer without complete external source assertions and unsupported constructs handled.
